limitations: All 64,572,998 source records passed exact independent source comparison and a byte-identical clean analytical rebuild. Local analytical and display packages are prepared; public hosting has not been tested.
Raw observations are separate source records and short parts, not a connected river centerline network. Records are never joined by segmentID or segmentInd.
width_m value 1 is an unknown-width sentinel; width_valid indicates usable width without altering width_m.

PMTiles is a zoom 8–12 display derivative with quantized geometry. At zoom 12, 304 source fragments of 0.0013–2.93 m collapse to a tile-grid point and are explicitly enumerated. All remain unchanged in the analytical GeoParquet.
The release excludes masks, tile index, and RSSA basin supplement.
No GEE parity, global independent scientific-accuracy assessment, current-condition claim, or producer-operation reconstruction is made.

Display validation compares every zoom-12 ID and selected tile attributes; geometry is checked on 13,061 frozen/source-selected controls (13,053 passes and 8 enumerated collapse exceptions). Eleven browser cases test five known problem locations and six broad geographic windows, not exhaustive geographic or scientific accuracy.

product_metadata.summary: The complete GRWL V01.01 raw vector observations in lossless GeoParquet, with a separately versioned zoom 8–12 detail PMTiles display. All 64,572,998 observations retain their source tile, ordinal, ten original DBF fields, part and vertex order, and XY float64 coordinates. Complete source comparison, clean analytical rebuild, global display checks and eleven frozen browser cases passed. These are local prepared releases; no product has been created or uploaded.
product_metadata.temporal_note: Static producer release derived from Landsat observations with varying source dates; not current river conditions or a time series.
